whatIsSection.title: What Are
whatIsSection.subtitle: Space maintainers are custom-made dental appliances used to preserve the space created when a baby tooth is lost earlier than expected. They prevent neighboring teeth from shifting, allowing permanent teeth to erupt correctly.

whyMattersBox.title: Why Timely Treatment Matters
whyMattersBox.paragraph: Early loss of baby teeth can lead to crowding, misalignment, and future orthodontic problems if left unaddressed.

items.title: Prevents Crowding
items.description: Without a maintainer, neighboring teeth can drift into the empty space, crowding out the permanent tooth.

items.title: Guides Proper Eruption

items.title: Reduces Orthodontic Needs

items.title: Supports Healthy Bite

items.question: What is a space maintainer?
items.answer: A space maintainer is a dental appliance used to keep the space open after a baby tooth is lost prematurely, allowing the permanent tooth to erupt in the correct position.

items.question: When does a child need a space maintainer?
items.answer: A child may need one if a baby tooth is lost early due to decay, injury, or extraction and there is a risk of neighboring teeth shifting.

items.question: Are space maintainers painful?
items.answer: No. The placement procedure is simple and comfortable. Children usually adapt to the appliance within a few days.

items.question: How long does a space maintainer stay in place?
items.answer: It remains in place until the permanent tooth is ready to erupt. Regular dental check-ups help determine the appropriate time for removal.

items.question: How much do space maintainers cost in Pune?
items.answer: The cost varies depending on the type of appliance and your child's individual dental requirements. A consultation provides an accurate estimate.

items.question: Can space maintainers prevent braces?
items.answer: While they cannot always eliminate the need for orthodontic treatment, space maintainers significantly reduce the risk of crowding and complex alignment issues.
